CareerQuest.description_key: {=taom_cq_capt_osg_t2_desc}Osgiliath's ruins must hold against the Shadow. Prove yourself worthy of the rank of Captain — win Gondor's battles, master the blade, and let your renown spread along the Anduin.

{=taom_lg_hands_desc}A master armourer forges a lord's gauntlets only for hands that have proved themselves in battle. Strike down enemies with your own hand and win battles, or bring the armourer your people's lord's materials instead; then a master armourer will fit you with them.

Objective.task_key: {=taom_lg_task_kills}Strike down enemies with your own hand

CareerQuest.description_key: {=taom_lg_legs_desc}Greaves fit for a lord are earned in the press of battle, not bought. Strike down enemies with your own hand and win battles, or bring the armourer your people's lord's materials instead; then a master armourer will fit you with them.

Objective.task_key: {=taom_lg_task_kills}Strike down enemies with your own hand

CareerQuest.description_key: {=taom_lg_shoulders_desc}A lord's mantle marks one who stands where the fighting is thickest. Strike down enemies with your own hand and win battles, or bring the armourer your people's lord's materials instead; then a master armourer will fit you with it.

Objective.task_key: {=taom_lg_task_kills}Strike down enemies with your own hand

CareerQuest.description_key: {=taom_lg_head_desc}A lord's helm is forged for a name that other lords fear. Strike down enemies with your own hand, take an enemy lord captive and win battles, or bring the armourer your people's lord's materials instead; then a master armourer will fit you with it.

Objective.task_key: {=taom_lg_task_kills}Strike down enemies with your own hand

CareerQuest.description_key: {=taom_lg_body_desc}The lord's harness is the last armour a master armourer forges, and only for a proven captain. Strike down enemies with your own hand, take enemy lords captive and win battles, or bring the armourer your people's lord's materials instead; then a master armourer will fit you with it.

Objective.task_key: {=taom_lg_task_kills}Strike down enemies with your own hand

CareerQuest.description_key: {=taom_lg_weapon_desc}The finest weapons of your people go to those whose deeds match the names they carry. Strike down enemies with your own hand, take enemy lords captive and win battles, or bring the armourer your people's lord's materials instead; then a master armourer will fit you with it.
